name: Gate lazy-require shadow radius simulation
target: Prove production formal-receipt fallback consumes the measured lazy-require candidate, preserves CLI-spawn tests, surfaces omitted full-sweep failures, and fails closed to full gate on opaque closure.
inputs: a module-import-only test and a real CLI-spawn test
observations: the conservative current radius includes both the CLI-spawn and module-import tests
the measured candidate keeps the CLI-spawn test and removes only the require-only module-import test
an opaque dynamic require in the test preload makes the production selector fail closed to a full gate
The production formal-receipt fallback selects the measured candidate files and carries prior failure IDs; an opaque graph returns no fallback and an explicit full-gate reason.
